asks: What happens to running computers when the engine stops?
answer: Computers outlive the engine: if it stops, running computers keep running under the rules they had. A hold still ends at its limit, which the helper keeps. Nothing can be changed until the engine is back: no fork, no restore, no new rule, and no stop asked through Silo. The price is one helper per computer.
